decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - 1		NSTD1	The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the hours of 0800 hours to 2000 hours Monday to Friday, and 1000 hours to 2000 hours Saturday and Sunday.

Condition : 4 - 1		NSTD2	The premises shall be occupied only as a physiotherapy sports injury clinic and for no other purpose, including any other D1 use, without the prior permission of the Local Planning Authority. Upon the cessation of the use of the premises for the purpose hereby permitted the use of the premises, unless otherwise permitted, shall revert to those permitted under A1.
description: Change of use from Retail to Physiotherapy Sports Injury Clinic.
